analyst_view.overall: OFI Crete (16th, 6 pts) host Anderlecht (15th, 6 pts) in Heraklion in a straight fight for a play-off place, with both clubs on two wins from four. OFI, in their first league phase after winning the Greek Cup, beat Hapoel Be'er Sheva 2-0 in the last round but drew 0-0 with Atromitos and have a mixed domestic run (sixth in Greece); Anderlecht under Danny Röhl won 3-0 in Bialystok and 2-0 against Salzburg, but only scraped a 1-0 over OH Leuven on Sunday with a late, disputed penalty. Neither side has a reported injury or ban for Thursday; Anderlecht defender Lucas Hey missed the weekend and two unnamed players were doubtful, so that is worth checking nearer kick-off. News this far out was thin (no proper match preview yet), the referee is not named, and the numbers already count both teams' recent form, so I leave every stat where the numbers put it for now.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals, 1.1 for OFI and 1.3 for Anderlecht. OFI score little at home in Europe (one goal against Rennes, none against Leverkusen) and Anderlecht have kept clean sheets in their two European wins, while their 1-0 over OHL was laboured; with no confirmed absences on either side I stay at 2.4.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.7 corners. OFI's corner output has dropped lately and Anderlecht's has been steady; the numbers already move for that recent form (about -1% for OFI, +5% for Anderlecht), and I found nothing on tactics or lineups that changes it, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.0 cards. It is a tight game between two sides level on points, but no referee is named yet and there is no derby edge or bad blood between them (both past meetings were 1-1 draws); Anderlecht's slight rise in cards is already counted (+4.6%), so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers expect 26.4 shots, with Anderlecht taking the larger share (15.8). They already cut OFI's shooting by about 13% for a poor recent run and raise Anderlecht's by 13% because OFI have been conceding plenty; with no new team news I stay at 26.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 9.7 shots on target. OFI's accuracy has dipped and they concede chances (both already counted, -6% and +10%); Anderlecht's attack around Bertaccini looked flat against OHL but that is one game, so I stay at 9.7.
